title: Active Directory Inactive Computer Audit
summary: Read-only Active Directory script for inactive computer audit.
description: Official OperatorOS ScriptForge seed script that collects inactive computer audit data for technician review, reporting, and customer documentation. This script is designed as a read-only audit/reporting baseline.
use_case: Use this script when building a Active Directory health report, onboarding baseline, recurring audit, or escalation packet.

safety.notes: Official OperatorOS read-only audit/reporting seed script. Review tenant scope and permissions before running.

requirements.name: ActiveDirectory PowerShell module with domain read access.

examples.title: Run report
examples.description: Runs the read-only audit report with default options.

output.description: PowerShell object output suitable for pipeline export, transcript capture, or manual review.

script_body:
# OperatorOS ScriptForge official read-only audit script
# Category: Active Directory
# Report: Inactive Computer Audit

$OperatorOSFrameworkPath = Join-Path -Path $PSScriptRoot -ChildPath '..\..\..\framework\OperatorOS-ScriptFramework.psm1'
if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $OperatorOSFrameworkPath) {
    Import-Module $OperatorOSFrameworkPath -Force
}

$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

Search-ADAccount -AccountInactive -ComputersOnly -TimeSpan 90.00:00:00 | Select-Object Name,LastLogonDate
